Subject: Re: Mobile handset upgrade request – ticket FIN-4471

Hi Priya,

Thanks for resubmitting the handset upgrade form. Finance has approved the device cost of £649 for the iPhone 14 under the standard refresh cycle, but the accessories bundle (case and wireless charger, £58) was coded to the wrong cost centre. Please ask your line manager to confirm the correct code — it should be MAR-COMP-02 rather than MAR-COMP-01 — and we can release the full amount. The order will be placed with the carrier once that's through, usually within two working days. If you need the phone before your client visit on the 14th, let us know and we can arrange a temporary loan handset from IT.

Best regards,
Tom Askew
HR & Finance Helpdesk
Marlow Instruments Ltd

Subject: Wedding leave – form query

Hello,

I'm getting married on 4 October and want to book the statutory five days of marriage leave plus four days of annual leave for the honeymoon. I've filled in the leave request in the portal, but it keeps splitting the marriage leave and the annual leave into separate entries, which is fine, just checking that's expected. One question: does the marriage leave have to be taken in the week of the ceremony, or can we spread it out? My partner works shifts so we may need to shift a couple of days to the following week. I've attached the marriage certificate request form as well — HR said they need a copy before the leave is approved. Any guidance would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Daniel Okafor
Accounts Payable

Hi all,

A quick reminder of the finance cut-offs for the rest of the quarter, since a few people have asked now that the new chatbot on the intranet is live and it sometimes quotes last year's dates.

| Run | Timesheet deadline | Approval deadline | Pay date |
|-----|--------------------|-------------------|----------|

Subject: Expense claim rejected – receipt missing (ref EC-2291)

Hi Marcus,

Your expense claim for the conference in Leeds has come back to us because one of the receipts is missing. The claim included:

- Rail fare (return, Leeds) — £86.40 — receipt attached ✓
- Hotel, 2 nights — £214.00 — receipt attached ✓
- Evening meal, 1 person — £32.10 — receipt missing ✗

Could you upload the restaurant receipt or, if it was a card payment, a copy of the card statement line showing the merchant? There's a short guide on the intranet under Finance > Expenses > Supporting documents, and the automated receipt-scanner will often pull the details straight from a photo of the statement if that's easier.

We can hold the claim open for 14 days before it lapses, so there's no rush, but the sooner it's in the sooner it's paid.

Kind regards,
Aisha Bello
Finance Helpdesk

Subject: Phone upgrade eligibility – policy summary

Hi everyone,

Following the refresh of the mobile device policy, here's a quick summary of who's eligible for an upgrade this cycle and what's involved. A few of you have been asking the HR assistant bot about it, and it's been giving out the old two-year rule, so please use the table below as the reference until the knowledge base is updated.

```json
{
  "policy_version": "4.2",
  "effective_from": "2024-07-01",
  "eligibility": {
    "standard_staff": "24 months since last handset",
    "field_sales": "18 months since last handset",
    "on_call_engineers": "12 months, with manager sign-off"
  },
  "device_cap": 650,
  "accessories_cap": 75,
  "requires_cost_centre": true
}
```

To start a request, complete the handset upgrade form on the portal and attach your line manager's approval email. Finance will check the cost centre and the carrier will confirm delivery, usually within five working days. If your current phone is broken or lost, flag it as urgent in the form and IT will arrange a loan device in the meantime.

If anything in the summary is unclear, drop a note to the helpdesk and one of the team will get back to you.

Many thanks,
Owen Pryce
HR & Finance Helpdesk
